title: Health Check Endpoint
description: Runnable liveness, readiness and startup health check endpoints in Python (FastAPI), JavaScript (Express), Go (net/http) and Java (Spring Boot Actuator), plus Kubernetes probe and Docker Compose manifests.
description_es: Endpoints de health check de liveness, readiness y startup ejecutables en Python (FastAPI), JavaScript (Express), Go (net/http) y Java (Spring Boot Actuator), más manifiestos de probes de Kubernetes y Docker Compose.
